name: Garage door repair & installation — independent, NW Cook / DuPage (residential + HOA/condo B2B)
summary: Job-based home service. Each 'customer' is one paid job (monthly churn = 100%, so active customers = jobs in the month; no recurring ARPC). Demand = company inbound leads (Google LSA/search, referrals, HOA/CAM, inspector and realtor requests) handled by the founder, ramping over 30 months (review/ranking build) to a single-territory plateau calibrated to franchise unit revenues (Access, ProLift, Precision FDDs). Technicians are hired by capacity (jobs per month); the founder does the first ~50 jobs/month himself (unpaid inside operating profit). Parts/doors are COGS; technician + van running cost is staff cost. Operating profit is before owner compensation.
evidence_notes: Revenue density: Access Garage Doors 2025 FDD — franchised units average $226k (yr1), $731k (yr2), $1.02M (yr3); COGS 46-47% of sales [B, DF-S001]. ProLift 2025 FDD — 40 franchised units avg $511k, bottom quartile $162k [B, DF-S002]. Precision 2026 FDD avg ticket $1,213 (2024: $706) [B, C8-S019/C8-S020].

Owner economics (seller-claimed, D): NW Chicago suburbs garage door firm, 1 employee, revenue $472k, SDE $171k (3-yr avg SDE ~$193k) [DF-S004]; St. Louis firm, 7 employees, revenue $2.27M, cash flow $317k (14%) [DF-S005].
Technician pay: BLS/O*NET 2025 Mechanical Door Repairers, Chicago MSA median $65,090; 25th pct $51,300 [C, DF-S006]. Loaded +25% (payroll tax, WC, benefits) = E.
Lead cost: LocaliQ 2025 'Garages' Google search CPL $81.45 [D, DF-S007]; Searchlight data via Valley Marketing: blended $145/lead, non-branded search $173, LSA residential repair $15-35 [D, DF-S008].

Parts: DDM Garage Doors (West Chicago) public online prices — residential torsion springs median $52 each; LiftMaster head units $456-880 [B, DF-S012]. Dealer accounts (SSC) are application-only [B, DF-S011]; Raynor requires $100k/yr purchases [B, DF-S009].

Model structure: 'founder_leads_per_month' = all company inbound leads at maturity (not just the founder's own prospecting). Plateau jobs/month = leads x booked% x sold%: cons ~62 jobs x $450 = ~$335k/yr (ProLift median-group avg $424k, bottom quartile $162k [B, DF-S002]); base ~133 x $575 = ~$920k/yr (Access yr-3 avg $1.02M [B, DF-S001]; Precision smallest-territory median $858k [B, C8-S019]); opt ~214 x $700 = ~$1.8M/yr (Precision smallest-territory avg $1.38M). Technicians capacity-triggered (~60 jobs/tech/month). Founder field labour is free inside operating profit, as in SDE.
Not modelled: maintenance-plan recurring revenue, commercial rolling-door work, seasonality (installs slower in Jan-Feb).
Churn-based stress tests and the churn tornado bar are not meaningful here (churn is structurally 100% in a job-based model); read CAC, ticket, margin, labour, hiring-threshold and demand tests.

drivers.sales_start_delay_months__source: Entity, Chicago Regulated Business License (Home Repair Services) or suburban registration, Home Repair Act insurance minimums, van purchase; ~1 month. Chicago licence category documented [A, DF-S014]; processing time MISSING.
drivers.sales_cycle_months__source: Emergency repair calls convert same day (Stage C memo; homeowner urgency).
drivers.founder_ramp_months__source: Months for inbound lead flow to reach plateau (reviews, LSA ranking, B2B accounts). Access Garage Doors franchised units: yr1 avg $226k, yr2 $731k, yr3 $1.02M, yr4 $1.20M [B, DF-S001] — an independent without brand/call centre ramps no faster (E).
drivers.founder_leads_per_month__source: Company inbound leads/month at plateau, back-solved from single-territory franchise revenues (see evidence note) [B, DF-S001, DF-S002, C8-S019]; independent with honest flat-rate positioning assumed to reach franchise-median, not franchise-average, volume in base (E).
drivers.lead_to_proposal_pct__source: Lead -> booked visit. Searchlight LSA book rate 38% (12 contractors, Jan-Apr 2026) reported in search summary [D, DF-S008]; garage-door emergencies book higher (E).
drivers.proposal_to_win_pct__source: Booked visit -> paid job (diagnosis on site; most repairs sold on the spot).
drivers.rep_new_customers_per_month__source: No sales reps: demand is inbound; technicians are capacity-triggered staff.
drivers.referral_new_per_100_active__source: Repeat/referral jobs per 100 jobs in prior month on top of inbound leads (E); HOA boards and inspectors re-refer.
drivers.monthly_churn_pct__source: Structural: each customer = one job (job-based model).
drivers.onetime_revenue_per_new_customer__source: Average ticket. Precision system avg $706 (CY2024) and $1,213 (CY2025) incl. upsell-heavy premium brand [B, C8-S019/S020]; Chicago dealer guide: torsion pair $250-400, cables $150-250 [D, DF-S036]; A1 quotes $350-750 single spring [D, DF-S037]; mix assumed 70% repairs / 15% openers / 15% doors (E).
drivers.gross_margin_pct__source: Unused (no recurring revenue); set equal to one-time margin.
drivers.onetime_gross_margin_pct__source: Gross margin after parts/doors only (labour is staff). Access Garage Doors COGS 46-47% of sales (install-heavy franchise mix) [B, DF-S001] = conservative bound; repair-heavy mix with $52 springs and $456-880 openers [B, DF-S012] supports 30-40% parts cost (E).
drivers.variable_opex_pct_revenue__source: Card processing ~3% + fuel ~3% of revenue (Junk King fuel 3.3% of sales as truck-trade analogue [B, WS18-S001]).
drivers.cac_per_new_customer__source: Per paid job (applied to all jobs incl. referrals — conservative). Blend: ~60% LSA at $25-49/lead, ~20% Google search at $81-173/lead, ~20% referral/B2B at $0, with ~55% lead-to-job conversion [D, DF-S007, DF-S008] => ~$95-100/job (~17% of ticket). Franchise local marketing ~12% of sales (College Hunks) [B, C8-S017].
drivers.fixed_marketing_per_month__source: Website, Google Business Profile tools, review software, van wrap amortisation, BNI/association dues.
drivers.dso_days__source: Homeowners pay at completion; HOA/CAM invoices net-30 (~15% of revenue).
drivers.inventory_days_cogs__source: Springs, cables, rollers, openers carried on vans/shelf; doors ordered per job with deposit.
drivers.dpo_days__source: New accounts start COD/card; SSC dealer accounts by application [B, DF-S011]; Raynor requires approved credit terms [B, DF-S009].
drivers.start_capital_injection__source: Van + tools + opening inventory + 3 months of fixed costs.
drivers.ev_multiple__source: Asking prices: $550k on $171k SDE (3.2x) [DF-S004]; $1.395M on $317k cash flow (4.4x) [DF-S005]. Asking ≠ sold.

staff.notes: Hired when jobs/month exceed founder capacity (~50) and every +60 jobs/month (≈3 jobs/day). Loaded pay: Chicago median $65,090 x1.25 [C, DF-S006] = $6.8k/mo + van insurance/maintenance ~$1.1k/mo (E). Capex/hire = used van, racks, tools, opening parts (E).
Chicago dispatcher median $58,900; CSR median $47,100 [C, DF-S033]; loaded x1.2 (E).
E — frees founder from field supervision.

overhead.notes: Commercial auto avg $245/mo small-business policy [D, DF-S034] + maintenance (E).

overhead.notes: Home Repair Act minimums $100k/$300k BI, $50k PD, $10k improper repair [A, WS18-S010]; GL small-biz avg $45/mo is a floor [D, DF-S034]; contractor rating higher (E).
Housecall Pro Essentials $149-189/mo [B, DF-S035] + AI receptionist/answering (~$150-200/mo, E).
